175:     file_handler.setFormatter(formatter)

300:                 r'\s+name="([^"]+)"\s*(?:string="[^"]*"\s*)?' +
301:                 r">(.*?)</" + DSML_BAR + "DSML" + DSML_BAR + "parameter>",
302:                 param_block,
